sections.heading: Senior Backend Engineer at Acme Corp
sections.body: Leading backend and distributed-systems work at Acme Corp, focused on reliability and performance at scale. Redesigned the caching layer, led a major architecture migration, and grew the engineering team through hands-on mentoring.

bullets.text: Cut API latency by 40% by redesigning the caching layer
Led migration of monolith to microservices for a 12-engineer team
Improved on-call reliability for the distributed systems this role owns
bullets.flag_reason: Would be stronger with a specific metric, like an incident-count or uptime reduction, if you have one.
